profile.headline: Certified: AWS Solutions Architect | .NET Full stack Developer | AWS AI Lead Developer | .NET Core (6.0/8.0/10) | C# | Appian Developer | Python | ReactJS | AWS | Agentic AI | Angularjs
profile.summary:
With over 15 years of comprehensive experience in IT, I specialize in the design and development of robust web, desktop, cloud, and service applications. My expertise encompasses C# with .NET Core (3.0/6.0/8.0), ASP.NET, Entity Framework, LINQ, Web API, ReactJS and WCF, along with a strong command of AWS services including EC2, ECS, Lambda, S3, DynamoDB, and more.

At present, I am a Senior .NET/AWS Lead Developer and AWS DevOps specialist at The Beneficient Company Group, where I lead the development of a cutting-edge microservices-based cloud application. My role involves designing and implementing cloud architectures, managing CI/CD pipelines with AWS CodePipeline, and driving the evolution of our systems with Agile methodologies. My focus on scalable and fault-tolerant solutions has significantly enhanced our application's performance and reliability.

Previously, at United Airlines, I played a pivotal role in migrating and developing cloud-based solutions for the airline industry, including the Navigator contact center application and the Flight Recommendation system. My contributions included leveraging AWS for high availability and fault tolerance, leading cross-functional teams, and optimizing infrastructure costs.

My technical toolkit is diverse, spanning .NET technologies, Python, PowerShell, and various CI/CD tools such as TeamCity and Ansible. I am adept at leveraging modern frameworks like Angular and ReactJS, and have a solid background in database management with MS SQL Server, DynamoDB, and Redis.

Certified as an AWS Solution Architect and Developer Associate, I continuously seek to stay ahead of industry trends and enhance my skills. My experience in Agile project management and process improvement drives my commitment to delivering high-quality solutions that align with business objectives.

I am passionate about translating complex business needs into actionable technical strategies and thrive in dynamic, collaborative environments. My goal is to leverage my expertise to drive innovation and efficiency in technology solutions.
